maturity.basis: Engineering estimate, not a measured benchmark.
maturity.changeReason: Scheduling continuity improved but no productive real Agent feedback round was newly qualified.

capabilities: Rust revalidates strict gap plans and converts their exact selected semantic scopes into the existing isolated request contract.
Fixed repository selection is declared in the plan policy without removing other scopes from gap accounting.
The actual strict execution loop consumes the Rust adapter and retains original plan and baseline byte digests.
Unsupported lanes or stale source/cut/policy/assessment inputs stop before Agent dispatch; no fallback scheduler is invoked.

pinnedPublicInputExperiment.interpretation: The fixed input requires operation verification rather than another semantic-only iteration; these are not live authority counts.

limitations: Controlled fixtures and CLI/script invocation, not a fresh model request or Agent execution.
Legacy cuts preserve their explicit historical selector; no automatic evidence-policy migration.
The loop still discovers assessment files by round number rather than validating the latest durable pointer.
No new live TableGit write, target build, calibrated case execution, feedback promotion or cross-repository closed-loop qualification.
Missing remote model configuration remains to be resolved before fresh HW Linux Agent execution.
